summary: Wendy Sherman, former US deputy secretary of state, weighs in on the hardening rhetoric between the US and Iran with a stark warning: "For the foreseeable future, if not forever, Iran will control the Strait of Hormuz." She says additional economic pressure from President Donald Trump is unlikely to make Iran's leadership cave. Sherman also discusses an upcoming summit between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russia sanctions legislation passed by the Senate and awaiting House action. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Trump Weighs Call for Capital Gains Tax Cuts as Midterm Boost
title_cn: 特朗普考虑呼吁削减资本利得税作为中期提振
summary: President Donald Trump is looking for new policy pledges he can present to voters ahead of the midterm election, according to a top economic aide and a former administration official, including potentially calling on Congress to cut capital gains taxes and create an exemption for certain home sales.

title: Brazil Assets Drop as Election Worries Start to Grip Traders
title_cn: 由于选举担忧开始困扰交易员，巴西资产下跌
summary: Brazilian assets trailed global peers on Tuesday as political concerns start to weigh on investor sentiment two months before the presidential election.
